LanguageData.CC_Settings_Hint: Each room type belongs to one cleaning column; use the arrows to move it. Rooms of that type are cleaned by the column's work type. To override a single room, select a colonist and right-click inside the room. The custom zone is painted from Architect > Zone.
LanguageData.CC_DesignatorCustomZoneExpandDesc: Paint the custom cleaning zone. Filth inside it is cleaned by the "custom" work column, even outside the home area.
LanguageData.CC_DesignatorCustomZoneClearDesc: Remove cells from the custom cleaning zone.
